headword: {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}
gloss: day trip; excursion without an overnight stay

definitions.explanation: A trip to a destination and back within the same day, without staying overnight. Common for sightseeing, hot springs, hiking, and other leisure activities.

examples.japanese: {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{箱根|はこね}→箱根：30712_hakone⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to Hakone on a day trip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気軽|きがる}→気軽：06865_kigaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧{日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}した→計画する：20998_keikakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I planned an easy day trip to enjoy on the weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です。
examples.english: If you use the bullet train, a day trip to Kyoto is entirely possible.

examples.japanese: {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}なら⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{少|すく}なくて→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: If it's a day trip, you can get by with less luggage.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧ (returning the same day) and ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (travel, trip). Japan's extensive rail network, especially the ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧, makes day trips practical even to destinations several hundred kilometers away.

Travel agencies and websites frequently advertise {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう} packages that bundle transportation, meals, and activities for a single-day outing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧: day trip plan/package
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧: day trip tour
- ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}→日帰り温泉：24775_higaerionsen⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: day trip to hot springs
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to go on a day trip

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧: same-day return — the core word, used without ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ when the context is clear
- ⟦{遠足|えんそく}→遠足：04107_ensoku⟧: excursion, field trip — typically a school or group outing, often on foot
- ⟦{小旅行|しょうりょこう}→小旅行：15918_shouryokou⟧: short trip — may include an overnight stay, unlike {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}
